context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 可視/リテラシー/言葉遣い/学ぼ/決行/見立て/置き換える/近接

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業務、可視化することで、改善のヒント、見えてくる。
lines.en: Ren — when you make things visible, improvement starts to show itself.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Opens with the name as anchor. Tone is professorial but not distant—the confidence of someone who has seen this pattern work. Slight weight on 'visible' and 'show.' Patient, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ITリテラシー、若手にも、磨きたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to sharpen my IT literacy—get better at it myself, and help the younger staff do the same.
lines.style: Careful, slightly fumbling on the first clause—thinking aloud rather than rehearsed. Second half firms up with quiet conviction. Respectful tempo. A small upturn of eagerness at the end, quickly caught.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 敬語、言葉遣い、社会人の必須だ。
lines.en: Honorifics, proper phrasing—those are non-negotiable for anyone who works professionally.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. Matter-of-fact rhythm. Not unkind, but the tone of someone stating what is simply true. Brief pause before the second clause—settling the importance of it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩から学ぼうと、毎日心がけています。
lines.en: Yes. Every day I remind myself to learn from the people ahead of me.
lines.style: Respectful and grounded. Spoken with quiet sincerity—not performing humility, but genuinely meaning it. Even pace, no rush. Slight warm undertone, like this is something he holds to.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクト、たとえ雨でも決行する覚悟だ。
lines.en: The project moves forward—rain or not. That's the resolve we need.
lines.style: Firm declaration. Weight on 'moves forward' and 'resolve.' No hesitation. Composed but animated—this is something he believes in. Slight breath of conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業界の見立て、御社のアプローチ、参考になります。
lines.en: Your company's perspective on the industry, your approach—it's really instructive for me.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, slightly awed. Opens softly. Builds toward sincerity on the final clause. Warm but not effusive. The tone of someone learning and grateful for it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 古い慣習、新技術に置き換える時代だ。
lines.en: This is the era where old ways get replaced by new technology.
lines.style: Philosophical clarity. Speaks with the authority of observation, not decree. Measured, almost reflective rhythm. Weight carries on the contrast—old to new. Composed, forward-looking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本社と近接のサテライト、勉強になります。
lines.en: The satellite office close to headquarters—being there has taught me so much.
lines.style: Warm, genuine gratitude. Softens slightly from his usual careful register. The words come a little easier here—this is something he's genuinely learned from. Trailing warmth at the end.
